title: Number of Pauli strings with a prescribed support
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$ be a set of coordinates. The number of Pauli strings $p$ of length $n$ whose support $\mathrm{supp}(p)$ equals exactly $S$ is $3^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: S is a finset of coordinates in Fin n
support of p equals exactly S
replaced:
The number of Pauli strings with support exactly $S$ is $3^{|S|}$, since each coordinate in $S$
is assigned one of the three non-identity Paulis.
